mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM task_info t JOIN carriage_info c ON t.source_carriage = c.id JOIN train_info tr ON c.train_id = tr.id WHERE tr.cluster_id = #{clusterId}
select * from task_execute_log where task_id = #{taskId} order by create_time asc

SELECT COALESCE(t.state, '未知') AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM task_info t JOIN carriage_info c ON t.source_carriage = c.id JOIN train_info tr ON c.train_id = tr.id WHERE tr.cluster_id = #{clusterId} GROUP BY t.state
SELECT COALESCE(t.state, '未知') AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM task_info t JOIN carriage_info c ON t.source_carriage = c.id WHERE c.train_id = #{trainId} GROUP BY t.state
SELECT COALESCE(state, '未知') AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM task_info WHERE source_carriage = #{carriageId} GROUP BY state
SELECT COALESCE(state, '未知') AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM task_info GROUP BY state
SELECT COALESCE(task_type, '未知') AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM task_info GROUP BY task_type
SELECT COALESCE(priority_level, '未知') AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM task_info GROUP BY priority_level
SELECT COALESCE(match_strategy, '未知') AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM task_info GROUP BY match_strategy

SELECT CASE WHEN target_vehicle_ids IS NOT NULL AND target_vehicle_ids != '' AND target_vehicle_ids LIKE '%,%' THEN '集群级' WHEN target_vehicle_ids IS NOT NULL AND target_vehicle_ids != '' THEN '列车级' ELSE '车辆级' END AS `status`, COUNT(*) AS `cnt` FROM task_info GROUP BY `status`
